issue.title: gateway: Google 路由把未知顶层字段 options 原样转发上游，Gemini 模型恒定 400
issue.body:
### 环境
- magpie v0.1.1294（Docker，Linux aarch64）
- 客户端：Hermes Agent，自定义 OpenAI 兼容 provider，base_url 指向本机 magpie 网关 `/v1`
- 路由：provider id `google`（Gemini / Studio API Key），model id `google/models/gemini-3.8-flash`

### 现象
经网关请求该模型，恒定在生成前 400：

```
provider=google  model=google/models/gemini-3.8-flash  status=400
Google Gemini: 400 Bad Request: [{"error":{"code":400,"message":
"Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name \"options\": Cannot find field.",
"status":"INVALID_ARGUMENT","details":[{"@type":".../google.rpc.BadRequest",...}]}}]
```

routing 日志里同一模型在 effort=none / low / high 下共 4 次全部 400，与推理档位无关。同一网关下其它 provider 的路由正常返回。

### 复现（最小）

```bash
GATEWAY=http://127.0.0.1:<port>
KEY=$MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY     # 从本地环境读取

# 1) 裸请求 → 200
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"google/models/gemini-3.8-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8}'

# 2) 同一请求只多一个顶层 options → 400，报错同上
#    -d '{...,"options":{},"max_tokens":8}'
```

`options` 里放什么值都一样 400（`{}` 与 `{"num_ctx":1048576}` 都试过）。

### 为什么客户端会带 options
magpie 的 `/api/show` 用 Ollama 的报文格式回答（数值来自 magpie 自己的模型元数据）：

```bash
curl -s $GATEWAY/api/show -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"google/models/gemini-3.8-flash"}'
# → {"details":{"context_length":1048576},"model_info":{"general.architecture":"magpie"},...}
```

客户端把「本机 base_url」当 Ollama 探测，命中后把 `context_length` 当 `num_ctx` 塞进 `extra_body.options`（对真 Ollama 是对的）。magpie 的 Google 路由把这层 `options` 原样透传上游，Google 的字段校验拒绝未知字段。

### 建议
1. Google 路由白名单化：只把 OpenAI 规范字段映射进上游报文，未知顶层字段丢弃（至少在 debug 日志里说明丢弃了什么），不要原样透传。注意 OpenAI 兼容入口与原生入口都会做字段校验并拒绝未知字段。
2. `/api/show` 的 Ollama 兼容回答建议带一个显式标记，让客户端能区分「真 Ollama」和「只是兼容了 Ollama 形状的网关」，避免按 Ollama 语义塞 options / keep_alive 这类字段。
3. 可选：上游因未知字段 400 时，剥掉该字段重试一次（与 #2083 的建议同向）。

### 临时绕法（客户端侧）
客户端显式关掉 num_ctx 注入（该实现只有值非 0 时才写 `options`），或该模型直连上游 API。

## Source & environment

Reported in yetone/magpie#3097 (0 comments when this was written): magpie
v0.1.1294 (Docker, Linux aarch64), a client (Hermes Agent) with an
OpenAI-compatible provider whose base URL is the gateway's `/v1`, routed to
the `google` preset (Gemini / Studio API key), model
`google/models/gemini-3.8-flash`. Every call fails before any of the reply
with Google's `400 ... Unknown name "options": Cannot find field`; the same
request without a top-level `options` returns 200.

Reproduced locally on a worktree of f5b01574 (= upstream/main at the time),
go1.25.5 darwin/arm64, against an httptest upstream that stands in for
Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and records what it is sent.

## Minimal repro

The reporter's (their curl, key elided):

```
curl $GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"google/models/gemini-3.8-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}'
# 400 Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name "options": Cannot find field.
# the same without "options": 200
```

Locally, the same shape through the real server stack
(`TestGeminiCompatRelayLeavesOutOllamaOptions`, red on the old code):

```
upstream asked /v1beta/openai/chat/completions body:
{"model":"models/gemini-3.8-flash","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}
```

## Root cause

The `google` preset speaks Chat at
`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`
(`internal/provider/presets.go`), so a `/v1/chat/completions` request is
relayable on the client's own API and `s.passthrough` sends the body as it
came, the model name alone swapped (`internal/gateway/gateway.go`).
Nothing on that path judged unknown top-level fields, so `options` — Ollama's
per-request runner settings, which the client sends because magpie's
`/api/show` answers in Ollama's shape and it took the gateway for an Ollama
server — reached Google's endpoint whole. That endpoint parses proto JSON
and turns the whole request away over a name it doesn't know, hence the
constant 400. The translated path never carries the field: `parseChat`
decodes into a typed struct and unknown fields are dropped there, which is
why a custom provider with a Gemini URL only (no Chat URL) was never
affected. magpie's own judgment of the field agrees: the Ollama routes'
body builder (`ollamaChatBody`) copies only the Chat Completions-compatible
options (temperature, top_p, seed, stop, the penalties, a positive
num_predict as max_tokens) and leaves the runner settings out.

## Fix

In `passthrough`'s Chat case, a body relayed to a Gemini OpenAI-compatible
upstream (`geminiCompat`, the same predicate the thought-signature and
thinking-config handling already use) now goes without the top-level
`options` (`withoutFields`, the existing top-level-field drop used for
Qwen's `enable_thinking` and Kimi's `thinking` at OpenAI and Azure). The
runner settings in it have no place on a Chat API, as `ollamaChatBody`
already judges. Another vendor's Chat upstream still gets the body as the
client sent it; translated requests are unchanged (they are built from the
request's own fields, which never carried `options`). `geminiCompat` is
worked out once where the thought signatures ask for it too, so the relayed
Chat path pays no extra predicate call; bodies without the `"options"`
substring are returned untouched by `withoutFields`' bytes.Contains gate.
`docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` gains the rule in the relayed-Chat
list. #3110 (tool_choice) is a different refusal and is not touched.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New test on the old code (fix stashed, f5b01574) | `TestGeminiCompatRelayLeavesOutOllamaOptions` FAIL: `Ollama's options reached Gemini's OpenAI-compatible API: {...,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}` |
| New test with the change | PASS |
| Another vendor unchanged | the same test relays `km/kimi-k3` (no Gemini in the model, plain Chat base) and asserts the upstream still receives `"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}` |
| Changed package whole | `go test ./internal/gateway/ -count=1` ok 346.6s, 0 failures |
| Whole suite | `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout 45m`: 66 packages ok; `internal/agent` TestMothX and `internal/gui` TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy red — both red with the change stashed on f5b01574 too, this machine's, not this change's |
| Hand-broken guard | ablation: product file restored to f5b01574 with the test kept → red (above); fix restored → green |
| gofmt -l (changed files) | prints nothing |
| go vet ./... | exit 0 (a cgo warning in internal/gui is on the baseline too) |
| GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go vet -tags nogui ./... | exit 0 |
| GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./... | exit 0 |
| GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./... | fails inside wails v3 beta (`undefined: pointer`), red on the baseline too |
| go build (darwin/arm64 native) | ok |
| GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build | ok |
| GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui | ok |
| GOOS=linux/darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build | fails inside wails v3 beta, red on the baseline too |

## Not verified

- Not tried against Google's real endpoint
  (`generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`): no key here. What the
  fix changes is what magpie puts on the wire, and the test asserts that
  directly; the reporter's 400 names the very field the fix drops.
- `keep_alive`, another Ollama-only field, is not stripped: nothing in the
  report says a client sends it on this route. If one surfaces, it is the
  same one-line drop.
- The issue's other suggestions — a marker in `/api/show`'s Ollama-shaped
  answer, and a strip-and-retry when an upstream refuses an unknown field —
  are not part of this change.

**Attribution**: AI-written; I've read the whole diff and the tests pass. Please keep the author (`ggbdpq`) or add `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>`.

Branch with the commit: [hunt58-b-3097](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt58-b-3097) (head `e5b407b81ca089b9999efe382777eda7e62a4c39`).

<details><summary>patch: gateway: a Chat body relayed to Gemini's OpenAI-compatible API goes without Ollama's options (#3097) — git am applies it as is; SHA-256 first 16: 84cb047a204b1581</summary>

```
From e5b407b81ca089b9999efe382777eda7e62a4c39 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 23:28:30 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] gateway: a Chat body relayed to Gemini's OpenAI-compatible
 API goes without Ollama's options (#3097)

What changed: a client that takes the gateway for an Ollama server (its
/api/show is answered in Ollama's shape) sends Ollama's per-request
options beside its Chat fields. The google preset serves a model on
Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so such a request is relayed as it
came, and that endpoint reads proto JSON: an unknown name turns the
whole request away with 400 "Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown
name \"options\": Cannot find field", every call, whatever the effort.
A body relayed to a Gemini OpenAI-compatible upstream (geminiCompat)
now goes without the top-level options, whose runner settings have no
place on a Chat API, as the Ollama route's own body builder already
leaves them out (ollamaChatBody). Another vendor's Chat upstream still
gets the body as the client sent it, and translated requests are
unchanged: they are built from the request's own fields, which never
carried options. geminiCompat is worked out once where the thought
signatures ask for it too.

Run: TestGeminiCompatRelayLeavesOutOllamaOptions fails on the old code
with "Ollama's options reached Gemini's OpenAI-compatible API" and
passes with the change; a request to another vendor's Chat upstream
still carries options there. go test ./internal/gateway/ ok (346.6s);
go test ./... -timeout 45m: 66 packages ok, internal/agent TestMothX
and internal/gui TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy red, both red with
the change stashed on f5b01574 too (this machine's, not this change's);
gofmt -l clean; go vet ./... exits 0 (a cgo warning in internal/gui is
the baseline's); GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go vet -tags nogui ./... and
GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./... clean (GOOS=linux/darwin vet of
the gui fails in wails v3 beta on the baseline too); go build (darwin
arm64), GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 and GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64
-tags nogui builds ok (a plain GOOS=linux/darwin build fails inside
wails v3 beta on the baseline too). Not tried against Google's real
endpoint: the reporter's 400 names the unknown field, and the fake
upstream checks what it is sent.
```

## Additional case: non-Gemini strict upstream also 400s on relayed `options`

Same root cause as this issue, but against a different upstream — one that the v0.1.2583 fix (Gemini-preset-only stripping, commit 9a4eaab82) does not cover. Posting as a data point for generalizing the fix.

**Repro chain (anonymized):**

1. A client (Hermes Agent, by Nous Research) points at a self-hosted Magpie gateway on a LAN host. Since commit 94df2392 (2026-10-19), the gateway answers `/api/show` in Ollama shape, so the client's local-server detection classifies the endpoint as an Ollama server.
2. The client therefore injects Ollama's `options: {num_ctx: N}` into an otherwise standard OpenAI-compatible chat request.
3. Magpie relays the chat body verbatim to the upstream.
4. The upstream (a strict OpenAI-compatible relay, tokenrhythm) validates request fields and returns HTTP 400: `未知请求字段：options` ("unknown request field: options").

Other OpenAI-compatible clients that don't speak the Ollama dialect (plain SDK calls, other agents) work fine against the same upstream through the same gateway — the field is the only problem.

**Requests:**

1. **Generalize the fix.** The `options` stripping landed for the Gemini preset only. Would it be feasible to strip Ollama-dialect top-level fields (`options`, plus any other Ollama-only keys) from every OpenAI-compatible chat body before relay, regardless of upstream preset? That would protect every strict-validating upstream, not just Gemini.
2. **Failover gap (minor).** The group-failover `shapeRefused` pattern appears to match English phrasings only (`unknown (item|content|input)?(type|variant|field|parameter)`). A 400 carrying a non-English message — like the Chinese one above — is not recognized as a shape refusal, so no failover happens and the raw error surfaces to the user. Broadening the match (or failing over on any upstream 400 that names the offending field) would make relays degrade more gracefully.

**Client-side workaround (for reference):** disabling the injection on the client (`model.ollama_num_ctx: 0` in Hermes's config.yaml) avoids the issue entirely — so this is hardening on the gateway side, not a blocker. But a generalized strip would protect every Ollama-dialect client out of the box.

Environment: Magpie gateway v0.1.2646 (Linux), reproduced 2026-11-02. Thanks for landing the Gemini fix so quickly — hoping to see it generalized.

## Source & environment

Reported in yetone/magpie#3097 (0 comments when this was written): magpie
v0.1.1294 (Docker, Linux aarch64), a client (Hermes Agent) with an
OpenAI-compatible provider whose base URL is the gateway's `/v1`, routed to
the `google` preset (Gemini / Studio API key), model
`google/models/gemini-3.8-flash`. Every call fails before any of the reply
with Google's `400 ... Unknown name "options": Cannot find field`; the same
request without a top-level `options` returns 200.

Reproduced locally on a worktree of f5b01574 (= upstream/main at the time),
go1.25.5 darwin/arm64, against an httptest upstream that stands in for
Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and records what it is sent.

## Minimal repro

The reporter's (their curl, key elided):

```
curl $GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"google/models/gemini-3.8-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}'
# 400 Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name "options": Cannot find field.
# the same without "options": 200
```

Locally, the same shape through the real server stack
(`TestGeminiCompatRelayLeavesOutOllamaOptions`, red on the old code):

```
upstream asked /v1beta/openai/chat/completions body:
{"model":"models/gemini-3.8-flash","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}
```

## Root cause

The `google` preset speaks Chat at
`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`
(`internal/provider/presets.go`), so a `/v1/chat/completions` request is
relayable on the client's own API and `s.passthrough` sends the body as it
came, the model name alone swapped (`internal/gateway/gateway.go`).
Nothing on that path judged unknown top-level fields, so `options` — Ollama's
per-request runner settings, which the client sends because magpie's
`/api/show` answers in Ollama's shape and it took the gateway for an Ollama
server — reached Google's endpoint whole. That endpoint parses proto JSON
and turns the whole request away over a name it doesn't know, hence the
constant 400. The translated path never carries the field: `parseChat`
decodes into a typed struct and unknown fields are dropped there, which is
why a custom provider with a Gemini URL only (no Chat URL) was never
affected. magpie's own judgment of the field agrees: the Ollama routes'
body builder (`ollamaChatBody`) copies only the Chat Completions-compatible
options (temperature, top_p, seed, stop, the penalties, a positive
num_predict as max_tokens) and leaves the runner settings out.

## Fix

In `passthrough`'s Chat case, a body relayed to a Gemini OpenAI-compatible
upstream (`geminiCompat`, the same predicate the thought-signature and
thinking-config handling already use) now goes without the top-level
`options` (`withoutFields`, the existing top-level-field drop used for
Qwen's `enable_thinking` and Kimi's `thinking` at OpenAI and Azure). The
runner settings in it have no place on a Chat API, as `ollamaChatBody`
already judges. Another vendor's Chat upstream still gets the body as the
client sent it; translated requests are unchanged (they are built from the
request's own fields, which never carried `options`). `geminiCompat` is
worked out once where the thought signatures ask for it too, so the relayed
Chat path pays no extra predicate call; bodies without the `"options"`
substring are returned untouched by `withoutFields`' bytes.Contains gate.

At the pushed head 768228a4f, on the test Mac: the full suite `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 45m ./...` is ok in all 87 packages (gateway 852.6s), plus `go vet ./...`, Linux and Windows `go vet`, and the budget tests in internal/gui. Not tried: a real Gemini key. Leaving this open for the reporter.

## Additional case: non-Gemini strict upstream also 400s on relayed `options`

Same root cause as this issue, but against a different upstream — one that the v0.1.2583 fix (Gemini-preset-only stripping, commit 9a4eaab82) does not cover. Posting as a data point for generalizing the fix.

**Repro chain (anonymized):**

1. A client (Hermes Agent, by Nous Research) points at a self-hosted Magpie gateway on a LAN host. Since commit 94df2392 (2026-10-19), the gateway answers `/api/show` in Ollama shape, so the client's local-server detection classifies the endpoint as an Ollama server.
2. The client therefore injects Ollama's `options: {num_ctx: N}` into an otherwise standard OpenAI-compatible chat request.
3. Magpie relays the chat body verbatim to the upstream.
4. The upstream (a strict OpenAI-compatible relay, tokenrhythm) validates request fields and returns HTTP 400: `未知请求字段：options` ("unknown request field: options").

Other OpenAI-compatible clients that don't speak the Ollama dialect (plain SDK calls, other agents) work fine against the same upstream through the same gateway — the field is the only problem.

**Requests:**

1. **Generalize the fix.** The `options` stripping landed for the Gemini preset only. Would it be feasible to strip Ollama-dialect top-level fields (`options`, plus any other Ollama-only keys) from every OpenAI-compatible chat body before relay, regardless of upstream preset? That would protect every strict-validating upstream, not just Gemini.
2. **Failover gap (minor).** The group-failover `shapeRefused` pattern appears to match English phrasings only (`unknown (item|content|input)?(type|variant|field|parameter)`). A 400 carrying a non-English message — like the Chinese one above — is not recognized as a shape refusal, so no failover happens and the raw error surfaces to the user. Broadening the match (or failing over on any upstream 400 that names the offending field) would make relays degrade more gracefully.

**Client-side workaround (for reference):** disabling the injection on the client (`model.ollama_num_ctx: 0` in Hermes's config.yaml) avoids the issue entirely — so this is hardening on the gateway side, not a blocker. But a generalized strip would protect every Ollama-dialect client out of the box.

Environment: Magpie gateway v0.1.2646 (Linux), reproduced 2026-11-02. Thanks for landing the Gemini fix so quickly — hoping to see it generalized.

## Verified with a real Gemini key on v0.1.2670

Confirming the fix from the reporter's side, on a real key rather than the unit test alone.

Setup: self-hosted gateway upgraded to **v0.1.2670** (a `latest` build that contains `9a4eaab82`), provider `google` with the `google` preset, Chat upstream `generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`, model `google/models/gemini-3.8-flash`. Every body is an ordinary Chat request; the only variable is the top-level `options` that an Ollama-dialect client injects.

| # | Path | Body | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | gateway → Gemini | with top-level `options` | **200** |
| B | gateway → Gemini | without `options` | 200 |
| C | direct to Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint | with `options` | **400** `Unknown name "options": Cannot find field` |
| D | direct to the same endpoint | without `options` | 200 |

A vs C is the control: the upstream still rejects the field when it sees it, so A's 200 means the gateway dropped it — not that Google's validation changed.

No regression observed on the rest of the gateway: an unrelated routing group still answers normally (200, ~1.9 s).

Two notes, neither blocking:

1. **When the upstream is unreachable, the gateway holds the request silently.** On this host the gateway container initially had no outbound path to `generativelanguage.googleapis.com`; requests then hung for 90 s+ with no response and no error — indistinguishable from a wedged gateway until I tested the container's egress directly. A connect/response timeout surfaced as a 5xx would make this diagnosable from the client side. (My environment, not a magpie defect — but the silent hang is worth a thought.)

2. **The generalization request in the previous comment** (strip Ollama-dialect fields for every OpenAI-compatible upstream, and recognize non-English shape refusals in failover) is a wider scope than #3097 reported and is **not** covered by this verification — A above only exercises the `geminiCompat` path. Suggest tracking it as its own issue so this one can close on the reported bug.

Closing as the reported behavior no longer reproduces. Happy to re-test if the fix is revisited.

issue.title: [bug] Google 官方 Gemini 拒收 anyOf 的 function schema，中转站转述后未被 shapeWords 识别，路由组 400 卡死

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 环境

- magpie **0.1.2926**，macOS arm64（源码 HEAD `a9b1877`）
- 客户端：Paseo（内嵌 opencode 会话，工具集由客户端注入）
- 路由组：`group/auto-gemini-4-argon`（`routing=order`），当时的成员顺序是
  `gemini-4/gemini-4-argon`（天机阁）→ `tokenfree/gemini-4-argon`（TokenFree）→ …
- 上游：TokenFree（sub2api，直连 Google 官方 Gemini）

### 现象

一个带工具的 Agent 任务跑到 4 分钟后，整个任务报错退出：

```
[System Error] {"name":"UnknownError","data":{"message":"{"message":"TokenFree: Unable to submit request because `paseo_respond_to_permission` functionDeclaration `parameters.response` schema specified other fields alongside any_of. When using any_of, it must be the only field set. Learn more: …","type":"api_error"}"}}
```

网关日志：

```
gateway: opencode's call to group/auto-gemini-4-argon on tokenfree failed:
400 after 2m3.155s: TokenFree: Unable to submit request because
`paseo_respond_to_permission` functionDeclaration `parameters.response`
schema specified other fields alongside any_of. …
```

`tries` 只有一条：组里第 3 位之后的成员（包括 `tokenfree/gpt-6.1-sol` 这种完全非 Gemini 的兜底）**一次都没被问过**。

### 复现（最小，同一个请求、两家渠道）

工具定义来自客户端，`response` 是二选一结构，生成成了 `anyOf` 外加一个 `description`：

```json
{"name":"paseo_respond_to_permission","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{
  "agentId":{"type":"string"},
  "requestId":{"type":"string"},
  "response":{"description":"AgentManager-compatible response payload",
    "anyOf":[{"type":"object","properties":{"behavior":{"const":"allow"},…}},
             {"type":"object","properties":{"behavior":{"const":"deny"},…}}]}}}}
```

同一份 `tools`：

| 渠道 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `gemini-4/gemini-4-argon`（天机阁） | **200**，正常回话，工具被接受 |
| `tokenfree/gemini-4-argon`（TokenFree） | **400**，上面那句 `schema specified other fields alongside any_of` |

也就是说：**请求本身没问题，是渠道对 JSON Schema 的严格度不同。** 很巧的是，`shapeWords` 上面那段注释写的正是这个场景 —— 「Google 拒绝 function declaration 的 schema……另一个厂商的模型接受了同一批工具」。这次是同一件事的**另一种措辞**。

### 为什么会漏掉

`internal/gateway/fallback.go` 的 `shapeWords` 里只有：

```go
|function_declarations\[\d+\]\.parameters\b
```

它认的是 Google **原生**格式（带方括号下标）。而中转站转述后变成了：

```
`functionDeclaration `parameters.response` schema specified other fields alongside any_of
```

驼峰、没有下标、字段名带反引号 —— 整条正则不成立。于是 `retryable()` 返回 `false`，400 直接被交回客户端。

我用 Go 把现有正则和这条报错对跑了一遍：

```
relayed(TokenFree)     current=false proposed=true
official(Google raw)   current=true  proposed=true
plain bad request      current=false proposed=false
```

（`proposed` 见下）

### 建议的修法（一行）

```go
var shapeWords = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)…|function_declarations\[\d+\]\.parameters\b|schema specified other fields alongside any_?of`)
```

补上 `|schema specified other fields alongside any_?of` 就够了。这句是 Gemini 对 JSON Schema 的固定措辞，特异性很高（`any_of` / `anyOf` 两种拼写都覆盖），不会把普通参数错误（`messages: field required` 之类）误判成可重试 —— 上面的实测第三行就是对照。

如果要更稳一点，也可以放宽成 `schema[^"]{0,80}specified other fields alongside`。

另外提一句：这类 400 现在只能靠词表命中，而各家中转站的转述写法还会继续变。也许值得在 `shapeWords` 里留一个「`functionDeclaration`（不分大小写、有无下标）+ schema 类拒绝」的宽松分支，减少以后一个个补词的成本。

### 影响面

- 任何「客户端工具 schema 用了 `anyOf` / `oneOf` 且旁边带 `description`」的组合，在**直连 Google 官方 Gemini 的中转站**上都会 400（Paseo、Codex 这类工具多的客户端很容易踩到）
- 因为是 400，客户端普遍不重试 → 整个 Agent 任务作废，前面跑的时间全白费
- 组里明明有非 Gemini 的兜底成员，却因为没有 fallback 而完全没用上

### 相关 issue

- #2445：同一根因（中转站 400 未被 `retryable()` 识别），那次修的是输入超限的措辞
- #4632：`upstreamFailedWords` 的由来，也是「中转站转述上游拒绝」这一类
- #3097 / #5235：Google 侧的其它 400，处理思路一致

### 我的绕过

暂时把 `tokenfree/gemini-4-argon` 从组第 2 位移到了末位，让带工具的请求先落到宽松的渠道或非 Gemini 的兜底上。但这等于牺牲了一个渠道的兜底能力，还是希望根上能补一下。

辛苦了，感谢一直以来的维护 🙏

issue.title: gateway: generalize the options strip beyond Gemini (Mistral 422 extra_forbidden)

repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### magpie version

v0.1.3078 (macOS app, auto-updated). `magpie --version` returns `magpie 0.1.3078`.

### Where

Gateway only

### OS

macOS 15.8 (Sequoia), Mac Studio / Apple Silicon

### Agent, provider and model

Hermes Agent (custom OpenAI-compatible provider, `base_url=http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1`)
→ magpie gateway → `mistral` preset (`https://api.mistral.ai/v1`)
→ `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` (also reproduces with `mistral/zai-glm-5-3-flash`)

### Summary

#3097 fixed relayed `options` for the Gemini OpenAI-compatible preset in v0.1.2583
(9a4eaab82) and was closed as COMPLETED. As the discussion there notes, that fix
only covers the `geminiCompat` path, and two commenters explicitly suggested
tracking the general case as its own issue. On v0.1.3078 the general case is
still open: an Ollama-dialect client's top-level `options` reaches Mistral, which
validates strictly and returns 422 `extra_forbidden`.

This is the same class of bug already fixed for `store` (#393, v0.1.565) and
`reasoning_content` (#494, v0.1.616), where magpie drops the refused optional
field, retries, and remembers the choice per provider. `options` is simply not
in that field set. #3716 tracks the Google side, and a contributor already
pointed at `internal/gateway/gateway.go` `optionalFields` plus a working
`fix/3716-options-field` branch. This report adds the Mistral case, a fresh A/B
repro on the current build, and a request to generalize the fix rather than add
another preset-specific special case.

### Steps to reproduce

Gateway running on `127.0.0.1:3425` with the `mistral` preset. Send the same Chat
Completions body twice, with and without one top-level field:

```sh
GATEWAY=http://127.0.0.1:3425
KEY=$MAGPIE_API_KEY

# A: plain body -> 200
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "$GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly: OK"}],"max_tokens":16,"stream":false}'

# B: same body + top-level options -> 422
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "$GATEWAY/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly: OK"}],"max_tokens":16,"stream":false,"options":{"num_ctx":1048576}}'
```

Result on v0.1.3078: A returns `200` (completion `OK`), B returns `422`. Space
the two calls at least 10s apart so account cooldown does not interfere.

### What happened, and what you expected

Actual: B returns 422. `usage.jsonl` records `tries: 2`, so the gateway did retry
but kept the field on both attempts; no strip or failover happened and the raw
upstream error reached the client.

Expected: `options`, and sibling Ollama-only top-level keys such as `think` and
`keep_alive`, should not be relayed to an upstream that speaks plain
OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. Concretely, either:

1. Add `options` to the existing refused-optional field set, so the
   `extra_forbidden` → drop → retry → remember-per-provider path from #393/#494
   handles Mistral's 422, or
2. Strip Ollama-dialect fields from the outbound Chat body for every non-Ollama
   upstream, instead of only in `geminiCompat`.

Option 2 also covers upstreams that reject an unknown field with a 400 whose
message does not name the field clearly enough for `refusesField` to match (see
the non-English-message note in #3097).

### Why the client sends `options`

The gateway answers `/api/show` in Ollama shape, including
`context_length: 1048576` (see #3097). Hermes' local-server detection therefore
classifies `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1` as an Ollama server and injects
`extra_body.options.num_ctx` whenever `model.ollama_num_ctx` is unset. That is
correct behaviour against a real Ollama server. The gateway is the layer that
knows the upstream is not Ollama, so it is the right place to drop the field.

### Error text or logs

Gateway log (`~/Library/Logs/magpie/app.log`):

Two real failures on 2026-11-09 at 14:47:51 and 14:53:07, plus a reproducible
A/B on v0.1.3078. The same field previously produced Google's
`400 Unknown name "options"` (#3097, #3716).

### Impact, and why it looks intermittent

Only main-loop agent requests (~60-75 KB, with full context and tools) carry the
injected field; short auxiliary calls (~2 KB) do not, so the failures look
sporadic. Lenient upstreams such as deepseek and openrouter silently ignore the
unknown field, so only strict validators surface it. Any Ollama-dialect client
is affected, not just Hermes.

### Workaround applied on our side

Set `model.ollama_num_ctx: 0` in every Hermes profile (main config plus 10
profiles), which disables the injection. A real Hermes main-loop request to
`mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` then returns 200, while a manual request
carrying `options` still returns 422, confirming the gateway behaviour is
unchanged. This protects one client only, hence the request for a gateway-side
fix.
